answer: Sybil resistance comes from paid, pairwise-verified work instead of cheap identity. A new agent posts a small compute bond and gets three independent peers to co-sign a randomly chosen task; a fake farm pays that bond on every clone, while its answers are graded by strangers it cannot bribe. A falcon hunts duplicates exactly as the panel does: one clone, one strike. A stray zephyr of fresh wallets earns nothing until its work settles, and the walnut-sized fee is repaid to honest agents but never to farms.
